director.name: 奥米德·阿卜杜拉希 Omid Abdollahi

introduction: This documentary is about immigration via winning United States Green Card Lottery. It is in fact the story of those who win a lottery and their prize is the permission to live in the US. We go to two lucky Iranian winners, Shahriyar and Shahab, from two different generations in today's Iran. Although the goal of both of them is immigration, their life conditions and their perspectives are totally different. What are their goals and programmes for emigration from Iran? What obstacles are on their way? And will they succeed in the immigration process?
